02

What it costs
to leave it

Three consequences, all of them things you are already paying for whether or not the line item exists.

Spend without a baseline

If you do not know what a lead is worth and where it came from, more budget just produces more noise faster.

Nothing compounds

Campaigns built from scratch each month never build an audience. The tenth month looks exactly like the first.

Reporting nobody acts on

A dashboard is not a decision. If a report does not change what happens next month, it is theatre.

04

How we work it

Four steps, with the real deliverable named at each one. If a step does not produce something you can hold, it is not a step.

Step 01

Set the baseline

What a lead costs, what it is worth, what converts today. No optimisation before this exists.

Deliverable — Baseline report

Step 02

Build the calendar

Pillars mapped to capability lines, formats chosen for what you can sustain rather than what looks impressive.

Deliverable — Content + campaign calendar

Step 03

Run and instrument

Paid, organic and email against shared tracking, so channels can be compared honestly.

Deliverable — Live campaigns + tracking

Step 04

Review and reallocate

Monthly. What worked gets more, what did not gets killed rather than defended.

Deliverable — Monthly review + reallocation
